description: Global, admin-managed catalogue of portfolio layouts. Shared by every user, so portfolios REFERENCE a template rather than embedding it - otherwise a template tweak would require rewriting every portfolio document. Very low cardinality and read-heavy: an ideal application-cache candidate.

templateKey.description: STABLE machine key mapping to a React component (MODERN_DEV -> <ModernDevTemplate/>). Unique and immutable once published - renaming it would break every portfolio referencing it.

availableSections.description: Sections this layout can render. The /builder UI must disable toggles that are absent here.

defaultSections.description: Pre-checked sections when this template is first selected.

sortOrder.description: Display order in the /builder template picker.

active.description: Admin soft-disable. Inactive templates disappear from the picker but keep rendering for portfolios already using them - never hard-delete a referenced template.
